script_text: The stars are staging a quiet revolution for Taurus this week — Mercury is first on the chopping block. Sunday night, Mars in Cancer squares your Mercury in your 3rd House, sparking miscommunications through Monday. By Wednesday, the Moon activates your 6th House of work, but Saturn's square from Aries drains your energy. Thursday transforms everything: Venus enters Virgo, aligning with the Sun in your 5th House of love. Through Friday to Sunday, Jupiter's trine to Pluto from your 3rd to 10th House opens career doors. Weekend energy lifts as the Moon enters Sagittarius, illuminating your 11th House. Thursday is your power day — Venus enters your 5th House bringing romance. Tuesday is your worst — Mars squares Mercury in your 3rd House causing communication chaos. Lean into Thursday's Venus glow and reconnect with someone you've quietly missed — earth signs heal through emotional honesty. Follow for daily Taurus updates.
